sources.snippet: A FastAPI service that reranks documents against a query using BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, served on port 8901. It runs on CPU and supports three backends: PyTorch, ONNX fp32 and ONNX int8 (default, fastest). Few measured requests per cell, so treat these as indicative. Qwen3-Reranker is an LLM with a ...
